mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dodo_show_activity_log (activity_id, submission_id, actor_id, action, detail, create_time) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{submissionId}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{detail}, #{createMillis})
mapper.update: UPDATE dodo_show_activity_log SET activity_id = #{activityId}, submission_id = #{submissionId}, actor_id = #{actorId}, action = #{action}, detail = #{detail} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT l.id, l.activity_id, l.submission_id, l.actor_id, l.action, l.detail, l.create_time, CASE WHEN l.action IN ('SUBMIT', 'RESUBMIT') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.nick_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(s.nick_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(u.user_name), '')) ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.nick_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), '')) END AS actor_name FROM dodo_show_activity_log l LEFT JOIN dodo_users u ON l.action IN ('SUBMIT', 'RESUBMIT') AND u.user_id = l.actor_id LEFT JOIN dodo_admin_user a ON l.action NOT IN ('SUBMIT', 'RESUBMIT') AND a.user_id = l.actor_id LEFT JOIN dodo_show_submission s ON s.id = l.submission_id
ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{start}
